name: Confirm the domain registered successfully
description: sale.order._action_confirm() calls Namecheap's domains.create automatically on order confirmation - check the namecheap.domain record's own state/chatter for a real success, not just that the order line exists.

name: If pointing this domain at hosting: update nameservers
description: Click Update Nameservers on the namecheap.domain record once the hosting account (02) is provisioned and you know its real nameserver values.

name: If using email on this domain: fetch/confirm the DKIM record
description: Click Fetch DKIM Record (namecheap_hestiacp bridge) so outbound mail from this domain doesn't land in spam.

name: Verify the domain actually resolves
description: A real dig/nslookup check, not just trusting Odoo's own record of success - DNS propagation can lag behind the API call succeeding.

name: Confirm the renewal contract line exists
description: Yearly auto-renewal only works if a real recurring contract line was created alongside the registration - check it before moving on, not a year from now when it lapses.
